summary: Ran prettier, type-check, and the full workspace test suite, which exposed 20 failures in apps/agent-server (resource roots, scripts, Pi config, session repository, discover-resources). Began fixing the resource paths by importing `cp`/`mkdir`, rewriting `globalResourceRoot`, adding an `adoptPiResources` helper that copies Pi's skills/prompts/AGENTS.md into the Gizmo data dir, and updating `pathScope` in resource-catalog.ts to use `relative` so Windows paths scope correctly.
decisions: Pi's agent directory is not used as a resource source; Gizmo owns the resources it loads and adopts Pi's existing skills/prompts/AGENTS.md into its own data dir once, without overwriting on later runs.
Resource scoping uses `relative(resolve(workspacePath), resolve(path))` and treats anything starting with `..` as global, fixing the Windows backslash pathScope bug.
errors: First edit attempt on resource-paths.ts failed because the multi-edit `oldText` did not match exactly (whitespace/newlines); re-read the file and re-applied successfully.

20 tests failed in apps/agent-server during the full run: extension-resources (5), run-script (9), pi-runtime-config (2), session-repository (1), discover-resources (3). Root causes include `packageResourceRoots` returning empty arrays, `adoptPiResources` returning false instead of true, session-repository workspacePath showing `C:\projects\...` instead of `/projects/...`, and discover-resources surfacing skills from global Pi/.agents dirs the tests expect filtered out.
